description: Source code for AnthropicFilesHandler class, which manages retrieval and transformation of batch message results from Anthropic API, including conversion to OpenAI format.

classes.name: AnthropicFilesHandler
classes.description: Handles Anthropic Files API operations, including retrieving batch results and converting them to OpenAI format.

methods.name: afile_content
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves file content (batch results) from Anthropic API and transforms it into OpenAI format.

methods.name: file_content
methods.description: Retrieves file content either asynchronously or synchronously based on _is_async flag, calling afile_content or running it in asyncio.

methods.name: _transform_anthropic_batch_results_to_openai_format
methods.description: Transforms Anthropic batch results JSONL bytes into OpenAI batch results JSONL bytes.

methods.name: _transform_anthropic_message_to_openai_format
methods.description: Converts a single Anthropic message into OpenAI chat completion format.
